'''John Shapiro''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Framingham tournament]] on 6 January 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|COTVG w/ S+V]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1597">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-framingham-ma-1-6-01d1597/ framingham-ma-1-6-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 7 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-07-framingham-ma-1-6-01d1597/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
